study_type_evidence.quote: The in vivo pharmacokinetic profile of CEND-1 after a single dose was evaluated in four non-GLP animal studies including Sprague-Dawley rats, Beagle dogs, cynomolgus monkeys and BALB/c mice
CEND-1 PK data from up to 28 participants receiving either 1.6 mg/kg (n = 14) and 3.2 mg/kg (n = 14) in the expansion cohort were analysed.

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: Sprague-Dawley, 6 male and 6 female per dose
in_vivo_species.quote: four non-GLP animal studies including Sprague-Dawley rats, Beagle dogs, cynomolgus monkeys and BALB/c mice
Female 4T1 tumour-bearing BALB/c mice (as above) each received a single intravenous administration of [3H]-CEND 1
including Sprague-Dawley rats, Beagle dogs, cynomolgus monkeys and BALB/c mice
Following an IV dose of CEND-1 at 5 and 50 mg/kg in male cynomolgus monkeys

clinical_detail: Phase I in metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, CEND-1 with nab-paclitaxel and gemcitabine; human median t1/2 1.6-1.8 h (Table 2 gives 1.956, 1.725, 1.598 h).

agents.name: CEND-1 (rat, male, 1 mg/kg)
agents.sequence_source: Not printed in the body; PEPlife2 gives CRGDKGPDC (iRGD), consistent with the body naming the agent 'iRGD/CEND-1' but not verified from the text.
agents.group_n_quote: Because of volume limitations in the mice and rats, each animal was used for one time point sampling, limiting the statistical analysis of the data.
agents.dose_route_quote: following the intravenous injection of CEND-1 at various doses (1, 5 and 50 mg/kg for rats, dogs and monkeys; 1.5, 4.5 and 13.5 mg/kg for mice)
agents.pk_quote: The average half-lives were approximately 20-25 min in mice, 30 min in rats and 40 min in dogs.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Mean (±SD) plasma CEND-1 concentrations over time in pancreatic cancer patients by dose level (1.6 mg/kg or 3.2 mg/kg)
concentration_time_figure.note: The concentration-time figure is the human study; the animal PK is reported only as derived parameters in Table 1, with no animal concentration-time curve.

bioanalytical_method: LC-MS/MS of plasma (assay details not given in the body)
bioanalytical_quote: Blood samples were collected for pharmacokinetic evaluations pre-dose and at 1, 5, 10, 15 and 30 min, and 1, 2 and 6 h post-dose in rats, dogs and monkeys
notes: All six PEPlife2 values verified exactly against Table 1's rat block: 0.805 (M, 1 mg/kg), 0.248 (F, 1), 0.460 (M, 5), 0.437 (F, 5), 0.341 (M, 75), 0.391 (F, 75) h. Two cautions. (1) The body's Methods say the rat doses were '1, 5 and 50 mg/kg' but Table 1 reports the top rat dose as 75 mg/kg; the discrepancy is the paper's and the table value is used here. (2) Table 1's footnote states each rat was sampled at ONE time point only, so these half-lives are fitted across animals rather than within an animal - the 3.2-fold spread between the male and female 1 mg/kg values (0.805 vs 0.248 h) should be read with that in mind, not as a sex effect. The body's summary '30 min in rats' is the rough average across all six.
